policy_summary: Both official Football-Data pages display 2026-11-24 updates. The data page limits free CSV/Excel use to private individuals and excludes commercial or data-training products using automated bots/scrapers/AI. The contact page limits intended use to personal betting or academic research, permits at most light automated access twice per week, and excludes commercial or AI data-training projects involving bots/scrapers.
policy_interpretation: No provider-issued permission exists for automated capture, frozen inference, or AI model training. The two-session weekly ceiling is not authorization. The current provider terms explicitly exclude AI data-training projects involving automated bots/scrapers; the project therefore keeps automated source capture, frozen-model inference, and AI model training denied. Authorization remains null. This is a conservative internal control, not a legal conclusion about every form of personal or academic research.
